format: JavaScript (ES6 module, using Jest for testing)
description: This file contains unit tests for 'tenantClient' utility functions related to tenant management, including normalization, session fetching, selection, and local storage handling.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various tenant ID representations to a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenant session data from the server and returns an array of tenants.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant, updates local storage, and makes an API call to set the active tenant on the server.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant ID in local storage, replacing legacy storage keys.
